digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler backend port / outbound comments and inbound translation
propositions: Neutral core modules outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py contain literal lazy-load keys that unconditionally instantiate Jira vendor code regardless of configured backend, violating backend-neutral architecture.

Rich-text ADF decoding and comment-length truncation must be routed through backend port roles (InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text and FieldSanitizer.fit_comment) to eliminate vendor literals from core.

The outbound-comment diff path performs both ADF decoding (via inbound mapper) and fit-to-limit comparison (via sanitizer.fit_comment with no send-side warning), with both operations resolved from a single select_backend call.

The public inbound_translate._normalize_adf_body function must remain importable by applier.py and apply_inbound_records.py, re-implemented to delegate to InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text to preserve the bug-1bb2-5da5 defense against raw ADF dicts reaching EDIT events.

All package-root core modules except inbound_fields.py (recorded exemption with rationale and follow-up ticket 556a-5a1f-adb3-4139) must not contain the string literal "rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira", enforced by test_backend_neutrality.py sweep gate.
Comment formatting and truncation behavior, inbound rich-text normalization, and the ADF-dict-to-text defense must remain byte-identical for Jira and be backend-neutral in implementation.
